title: Shadows
_map: Shadows (stretch, usually Y3). Big idea: light travels in straight lines; shadows form where it's blocked. Creative: make the biggest and smallest shadow of the robot by moving the lamp.
_story: The robot sees a giant robot on the barn wall and gets scared. It's only its shadow. Ismaeel moves the lamp to make the shadow huge and tiny.
_stepChain: light travels in straight lines (disco: reflect) → the robot blocks some light → the dark shape behind it is a shadow → move the lamp closer: bigger shadow → further: smaller → the robot thinks moving further makes it bigger

talk.goodAnswer: something blocks the light, and light can't bend round it, so there's a dark shape behind.

talk.ask: How do you make a shadow bigger?
talk.goodAnswer: move the light closer to the object.

handsOn: In a dark room, shine a torch at your hand in front of a wall. Move the torch closer, then further. Make a shadow puppet of an animal!

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: Aaah! There's a giant dark robot on the barn wall! Oh. It moves when I move. Is that me?

Light travels in straight lines. The robot blocks some of the lamp's light, and light can't bend round it. So behind the robot there's a dark patch, the same shape as the robot. That dark patch is called a shadow.
Now we move the lamp closer to the robot.

question.prompt: What will happen to the shadow?
question.reveal: Bigger! The lamp is close, so the robot blocks a wide fan of light.

narration.speaker: robot
narration.text: I want a tiny shadow. So I'll move the lamp closer still!

question.prompt: How do you make the shadow smaller?
question.onRight: Yes. Move the lamp further away, and the shadow shrinks.

0.mistake: mixed up which way makes the shadow smaller
0.hint: When the lamp came closer, did the shadow grow or shrink?
0.say: Moving the lamp closer made the shadow bigger. To shrink it, move the lamp further away.

rule.text: Blocked light makes a shadow. Closer light, bigger shadow.
rule.ask: Can you say how a shadow is made, and how to make it bigger? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: Light travels in straight lines. When something blocks it, there's a shadow behind. Move the light closer, and the shadow gets bigger.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: when is your shadow longest outside?
bonus.reveal: Early morning or evening, when the sun is low in the sky. At midday it's short.
